terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
Article 1 (Purpose)
These terms govern the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the Seller (hereinafter "Member") and SpaceMatch (hereinafter "Platform") regarding the use of the pop-up store matching service.

Article 2 (Definitions)
1. "Service" refers to all online services provided by the Platform, including space search, tenancy applications, and matching.
2. "Seller" refers to a brand or individual business that applies for tenancy through the Service.
3. "Vendor" refers to a space provider that registers spaces and selects sellers.

Article 3 (Service Provision)
1. The Platform provides: Space search, tenancy application management, communication support, and community features.
2. Services are available 24/7 in principle.

Article 4 (Membership)
1. Registration requires agreeing to these terms and submitting the required information.
2. The Platform may refuse registration in cases of identity theft, false information, or service disruption.

Article 5 (Member Obligations)
1. Members must provide accurate information and update changes promptly.
2. Prohibited: identity fraud, illegal activities, service disruption, and harm to other users.

These terms are effective from February 8, 2026.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
SpaceMatch (hereinafter "Platform") protects user personal information in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

Article 1 (Personal Information Collected)
1. Required: Email, password, brand name, business registration number
2. Optional: Instagram account, brand description, profile photo
3. Automatically collected: IP address, access time, browser information

Article 2 (Purpose of Collection)
1. Member management: identity verification, account management
2. Service provision: space matching, tenancy processing, notifications
3. Service improvement: usage statistics, quality enhancement

Article 3 (Retention Period)
Personal information is destroyed immediately upon withdrawal. Information required by law is retained for the legally mandated period.

This policy is effective from February 8, 2026.

marketing.title: Marketing Consent
marketing.content:
SpaceMatch may send marketing information to provide better services.

1. Content: New space listings, popular space recommendations, events, and promotions
2. Methods: Email, in-app notifications
3. Withdrawal: You may withdraw consent at any time.
4. Note: Essential notifications will be sent regardless of marketing consent.

These terms govern the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the Vendor (Space Host, hereinafter "Member") and SpaceMatch regarding the pop-up store matching service.

Article 2 (Definitions)
1. "Service" refers to space registration, seller matching, and tenancy management services.
2. "Vendor" refers to a space provider that registers spaces and attracts sellers.

Article 3 (Vendor Registration)
1. Vendor registration requires administrator approval.
2. Providing false information may result in cancellation.

These terms are effective from February 8, 2026.
